verdict.rationale: Mailchimp is a marketing-automation product, so this story applies to it. However, the evidence pack only mentions automations generically ('Enhanced automations', Analytics AI explaining which automations move revenue). Nothing documents viewing an individual contact's position within an automation, or removing and re-entering a contact without disrupting the flow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
